findings.description: Underfull hbox badness 1009: actual page has moderate loose spacing but remains readable without clipping or overlap; literal source hard hyphens and marker interruptions retained.
Sparse source-bearing ending retains closing blessing, Roman dating clause, PIVS PP. X subscription and final historical note before source apparatus and rights colophon.

limitations: Vatican archival OCR reconstruction; bounded geometry and note review does not establish original-print glyph identity or whole-source lexical collation.
Literal OCR spelling, hard hyphens, marker interruptions and damaged note labels remain. No translation or new rights clearance assessed.
Source admission, installation, canonical copy and deployment remain outside reviewer authority.

Three initial help-only Python tool invocations omitted environment guards; possible implicit bytecode writing cannot be excluded. All substantive replays and final whole-library validation used both guards.
